sql: WITH RankedPay AS (SELECT f.family, f.family_label, f.comp_mid_usd, d.company_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.family ORDER BY f.comp_mid_usd DESC) as rn FROM fct_posting f INNER JOIN dim_company d ON f.company_key = d.company_key WHERE f.is_open = TRUE AND f.remote_us = TRUE AND f.comp_mid_usd IS NOT NULL) SELECT family, family_label, comp_mid_usd, company_name FROM RankedPay WHERE rn = 1
